Pricing FAQs

Is the Free plan really free forever?▾
Yes — always. No credit card required. You get a personalised 7-day meal plan every week, a grocery list, and push reminders. Forever free.
What happens after the 7-day trial on paid plans?▾
You'll be charged at your chosen plan rate (₹199, ₹499, or ₹999/month). You can cancel anytime before the trial ends — no charge.
Can I switch between plans?▾
Yes. Upgrade or downgrade at any time from your account settings. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades at the end of your billing cycle.
Is my payment secure?▾
Yes. All payments are processed through Razorpay (PCI-DSS Level 1 certified). We never store your card details.
Do family profiles each get their own personalised plan?▾
Yes — each family member gets a fully personalised plan based on their own health condition, dietary preference, and regional cuisine. Not a shared plan.
Do you offer student or annual discounts?▾
Annual plans are coming soon with significant savings. Student discounts — email hello@mealcoreai.com and we'll sort you out.
